t01.reasoning: Primary DB down with near-total checkout failure.
t01.suggested_action: Declare incident; follow db-failover runbook; page DB on-call.

t02.suggested_action: Open SEV1; check identity dependency health and recent config pushes.

t03.reasoning: Regional brownout with elevated errors and latency.
t03.suggested_action: Page regional on-call; check eu-west-1 capacity and recent canary.

t04.reasoning: Backlog already past critical and still rising past SLO.
t04.suggested_action: Scale consumers; pause non-critical producers; monitor lag.

t05.reasoning: Stateful disk will fill within hours and stop ingest.
t05.suggested_action: Expand volume or purge safe logs; verify retention job.

t06.reasoning: Successful backup notification with no errors.

t08.reasoning: Isolated replica OOM with spare capacity.
t08.suggested_action: File ticket to bump memory limit next business day.

t09.reasoning: Canary flake with healthy production and auto-rollback.
t09.suggested_action: Review canary logs tomorrow; no page.

t11.suggested_action: Isolate hosts; engage IR; preserve forensics.

t12.reasoning: User-visible media failures from origin fetch errors.
t12.suggested_action: Check origin health and recent media deploy.

t13.reasoning: Latency up but within SLO with headroom.

t14.suggested_action: Check webhook worker and downstream bank API status.

t15.reasoning: Single-host CPU without corroborating errors; likely noisy.
t15.suggested_action: Check metrics; if isolated, ticket for capacity review.

t15::metrics.reasoning: Single-host CPU without corroborating errors; likely noisy. Metrics show no corroborating error spike.
t15::metrics.suggested_action: Check metrics; if isolated, ticket for capacity review.

t16.reasoning: Critical replica lag breaking dependent jobs.
t16.suggested_action: Investigate replica IO; pause heavy analytics; consider re-clone.

t18.reasoning: AZ network partition with customer impact.
t18.suggested_action: Declare SEV1; shift traffic off az-b; engage network on-call.

t19.reasoning: Spare disk with existing ticket; no active impact.

t20.suggested_action: Scale redis; flush hot keys carefully; watch error rate.

t21.reasoning: Public cert expires within a day and renew failed.

t23.reasoning: Unauthorized mass delete risking data loss.
t23.suggested_action: Stop job; lock account; assess restore need.

t25.reasoning: Detector-only anomaly without user symptom; treat as watch.
t25.suggested_action: Pull metrics; escalate only if errors/latency confirm.

t25::metrics.reasoning: Detector-only anomaly without user symptom; treat as watch. Metrics show no corroborating error spike.
t25::metrics.suggested_action: Pull metrics; escalate only if errors/latency confirm.

x01.reasoning: Global gateway outage after config push.

x02.reasoning: SLO burn tied to new ranking flag.
x02.suggested_action: Disable ranking flag; verify error rate drop.

x05.suggested_action: Restart consumers; check poison messages; page billing.

x06.reasoning: Object store outage with user-visible breakage.
x06.suggested_action: Declare incident; follow vendor status; enable degrade mode.

x08.suggested_action: Raise limits carefully or shed load; communicate status.

x09.reasoning: Expected ETL CPU with no error signal.
x09.suggested_action: Confirm metrics flat for errors; ack without incident.

x09::metrics.reasoning: Expected ETL CPU with no error signal. Metrics show no corroborating error spike.
x09::metrics.suggested_action: Confirm metrics flat for errors; ack without incident.

x10.reasoning: DNS failure cascading across critical paths.
x10.suggested_action: Page platform; restore CoreDNS; consider static fallbacks.
